test_title: PYST 47: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 03 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What was the major demographic feature of India at the time of independence?

options.text: High death rate and infant mortality

solution:
The correct answer is __**High death rate and infant mortality**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• At the time of independence in 1947, India had a very high **death rate** and **infant mortality rate**, primarily due to lack of healthcare facilities, malnutrition, and widespread diseases.
 
• The **infant mortality rate** was alarmingly high, with a significant percentage of children not surviving beyond their first year of life.
 
• India faced widespread epidemics such as cholera, malaria, and tuberculosis, which further contributed to the high death rate.
 
• Limited access to medical care and poor sanitation were major contributors to the demographic challenges at the time.
 
• The life expectancy during independence was also very low, around **32 years**, due to the high prevalence of diseases and poor living conditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **High life expectancy**

 
 
• Life expectancy refers to the average number of years a person is expected to live based on current mortality trends.
 
• At the time of independence, India's life expectancy was extremely low (around 32 years), so this option is incorrect.
 
• Over the years, improvements in healthcare, nutrition, and sanitation have significantly increased life expectancy in India, which is now over 70 years.
 
 
 
• **Aging population**
 
 
• An aging population refers to a demographic trend where the proportion of elderly people in the population increases.
 
• At independence, India had a predominantly young population, with a high birth rate and a low life expectancy, making this option incorrect.
 
• Currently, India still has a young population, but an aging population is expected to emerge as a concern in the future.
 
 
 
• **Low birth rate**
 
 
• Birth rate refers to the number of live births per thousand people in a year.
 
• At the time of independence, India had a very high birth rate, not a low one, due to cultural and societal norms, making this option incorrect.
 
• In recent decades, the birth rate has declined due to family planning initiatives and increased awareness.
